crossRefs.note: When they had come, they asked him, “Teacher, we know that you are honest, and don’t defer to anyone; for you aren’t…
The ox knows his owner, and the donkey his master’s crib; but Israel doesn’t know. My people don’t consider.”
“A son honors his father, and a servant his master. If I am a father, then where is my honor? And if I am a master…
But don’t you be called ‘Rabbi,’ for one is your teacher, the Christ, and all of you are brothers.
“Why do you call me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ and don’t do the things which I say?
You call me, ‘Teacher’ and ‘Lord.’ You say so correctly, for so I am.
If I then, the Lord and the Teacher, have washed your feet, you also ought to wash one another’s feet.
Jesus said to her, “Mary.” She turned and said to him, “Rabboni!” which is to say, “Teacher!”

parallels.note: Immediately he came to Jesus, and said, “Hail, Rabbi!” and kissed him.

translations.web: When he had come, immediately he came to him, and said, “Rabbi! Rabbi!” and kissed him.
translations.bsb: Going directly to Jesus, he said, “Rabbi!” and kissed Him.
translations.kjv: And as soon as he was come, he goeth straightway to him, and saith, Master, master; and kissed him.
translations.asv: And when he was come, straightway he came to him, and saith, Rabbi; and kissed him.
